title: refactor(ci): unify lint/test/release workflows and modernize actions/deps
author: Jordan Lee
description: Unify disparate GitHub Actions workflows for lint, test, and release into a smaller set of reusable workflows and update action pins and Node versions for hygiene and reliability. Motivation: we have multiple repo-specific workflow fragments that drift, which increases maintenance cost and causes flaky CI behavior. This PR consolidates common jobs into reusable workflows under .github/workflows/, standardizes caching and concurrency, bumps actions to v4 where available, upgrades setup-node matrices to node 18/20, and tightens release automation to reduce duplicate releases. Checklist: - [x] Extract common jobs to reusable workflows (.github/workflows/reusable-*.yml) - [x] Replace duplicated job definitions in repo-level workflows with uses: reusable-workflows - [x] Bump actions/checkout@v3 -> actions/checkout@v4, actions/setup-node@v3 -> @v4 where stable - [x] Add concurrency groups and cancel-in-progress for PR noise reduction - [x] Add explicit cache keys for build/test to reduce thrash - [x] Validate unit/integration matrix across Node 18 and Node 20 - [x] Update release workflow to use single-source tagging and dedupe artifact uploads - [x] Run CI across core monorepo packages and a representative sample of smaller repos Notes: kept a small set of repo-level overrides for platform-specific jobs (private installer and helm charts) to preserve required secrets/permissions. This PR intentionally avoids changing any runtime code; focus is CI/system-level changes so release notes are minor. Related: ENG-1723 implementation plan and incident follow-up from SUP-78 that identified flaky action versions.
commits: a1b2c3d: extract reusable workflows and move common lint/test jobs
d4e5f6a: bump actions/checkout@v4 and actions/setup-node@v4, update node matrix
b7c8d9e: tighten release workflow, dedupe artifact upload and tag handling
f0e1d2c: fix cache keys and add concurrency groups, address reviewer feedback
file_snippets: concurrency: group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }} cancel-in-progress: true
- uses: actions/setup-node@v4 with: node-version: ${{ matrix.node }} cache: 'npm'
- name: Restore build cache uses: actions/cache@v4 with: key: ${{ runner.os }}-build-${{ hashFiles('**/package-lock.json') }}
review_comments: Priya Nair (reviewer): Can we limit the Node 20 matrix to just packages that have been verified? Running full matrix increased minutes last time.
Jordan Lee (author): Good point, adjusted matrix to run Node 20 only for core packages and a representative sample for SDKs. See test.yml matrix.include entries.
Marco Gutierrez (reviewer): Release workflow did duplicate tag creation twice under race conditions. Please ensure tag creation is idempotent.

Jordan Lee (author): Updated release.yml to use if: steps.tag.outputs.created == 'true' guard and unified tagging into a single step with retries. Added a lock via concurrency for the release workflow.
Elena Rossi (reviewer): Lint job for python SDK uses an older tox env, tests failing on 3.12 matrix. Please pin tox and add fallback.
Jordan Lee (author): Pinned tox to 4.6 in python CI and added a fallback job that runs only on push to main. All failing checks rerun and cleared.
Priya Nair (approver): Approved after fixes. Left a suggestion to add a short docs page explaining reusable workflows for maintainers.
Jordan Lee (author): Added docs/ci/README.md with examples and migration notes per suggestion.
ci_checks: release-smoke: initial failure due to race condition, rerun success
merge_outcome: merge_commit_message: "Squash: refactor(ci): unify lint/test/release workflows and modernize actions/deps"
release_notes: Consolidated CI workflows to reduce maintenance overhead and improve cache hit rates.
Bumped GH Actions pins (checkout@v4, setup-node@v4, cache@v4) and standardized Node matrices (18 & 20 where applicable).
Release workflow deduplicated to prevent duplicate tags and artifact uploads.
Added docs/ci/README.md explaining reusable workflows and migration steps for repos.
